custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the anatomical correctness of the tail flukes. Grey whales have very broad, paddle-like flukes with a straight or slightly concave trailing edge and a median notch. Ensure the AI hasn't generated a humpback-style fluke (which has a more wavy edge) or an orca-style fluke. Check if the mottling pattern is consistent with grey whale scarring (barnacles/lice) rather than random noise. Evaluate the water interaction critically; AI often fails to render realistic splash/displacement when large objects exit water.
